claim_boundary: This matrix maps every frontend-foundation capability to one exact phase and work-package owner. Checkpoint C and Phase C acceptance remain suspended. Focused offline evidence covers FindingReport publication/query/readback, recursive request validation, export deletion/recovery, provenance, paging, explicit populated-migration unavailability, and the corrected ADR-0038 targeted-verification candidate: an unseeded native named-pipe path performs real fresh-snapshot capture, separately owned semantic acquisition, production dependency/correlation planning, preparation-owned input-manifest retention, exact managed-analysis-v1 successor admission, completion, and lineage readback. Preparation readback is revision-coherent and validates historical lifecycle, snapshot, acquisition, publication, provenance, application-link, and payload evidence before returning bounded history. Production planning retains qualified unsupported, inaccessible, and malformed processing gaps as limited plans, while identity/scope failures remain non-startable. StartTargetedVerification remains native-only-never-map and no renderer authority is granted. No desktop delivery, broad semantic accuracy, semantic-oracle qualification, M2 activation, or M2 acceptance is claimed.
